items.title: Jimmy Cobb — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bob James wrote a lot of arrangements for – that we played.

ctx.x: Bob James. Bob James wrote a lot of arrangements for – that we played. It was good. The arrangements were good. We got them down. The whole thing was nice. We
played a lot of good venues. We played hotel rooftops and that kind of thing. We played symphony orchestras and Carnegie Hall.
